file_write.scope: Only scripts/adjust_pvalues.py may create the user-specified result and validation files beneath the current working directory, using create-exclusive publication without replacement.
file_write.reason: The bounded helper must publish a new correction result or fail-closed validation record; strict path checks and create-exclusive publication prevent input mutation and overwrite.

target_enforcement.openai: Host permission gate must restrict writes to explicit new local output paths; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.claude: Host permission gate must restrict writes to explicit new local output paths; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.generic: Run locally and allow only explicit create-exclusive outputs below the current working directory.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit write approval is required for new output paths inside the current workspace.
